summary.content:
Today's selection covers 99 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 69 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: The vibe-coding revolution is coming to all the gadgets
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, Krebs on Security and others
• **Fresh Content**: 16 articles published in the last 24 hours
